paragraphs.text: Nazar , also known as the Velvet Fang , is a vampire warlock from an unknown plane.

Nazar is a character who debuted in Foundations Jumpstart as part of the Black Vampires deck . He is a light-skinned vampire with pointed ears. Nazar wears several layers of robes, with the outer layer being accented with red tendrils rising out of it at various points. He wields a staff with a skull as its top. He is associated with feeding counters to represent him gaining life via feeding on others.
